skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown inline code, documentation links, placeholders, and environment variable examples. The real risks are limited to user-facing setup guidance that installs or runs external code, especially the unpinned AgenticOS clone, install, and start command.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the AgenticOS repository to a reviewed commit or release, separate clone, install, and run steps, and require users to review source and dependency lockfiles before execution.

remediation.issue: Package installation command lacks verification guidance
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to install ChainGPT packages from trusted registries, pin versions, and review package provenance before use in production.

remediation.issue: Referenced support files are missing from the package
remediation.suggestion: Include the referenced reference, template, example, pattern, migration, MCP, and mock-server files, or remove claims that the skill can read them.

content.value_statement: Web3 developers need clear API guidance for ChainGPT products before they write integration code. This skill summarizes endpoints, SDKs, costs, and implementation patterns for ChainGPT-powered applications.
actual_capabilities: Explains the ChainGPT base URL, bearer authentication model, rate limit, dashboard, and credit system.
Provides JavaScript, Python, and REST quick starts for ChainGPT chat, NFT, smart contract, audit, and news products.
Maps ChainGPT products to package names, endpoints, model identifiers, and stated per-request credit costs.
Guides project planning for chatbots, NFT minting services, contract audit pipelines, crypto news dashboards, and Twitter agents.
Lists implementation conventions for API key handling, streaming responses, error handling, session identifiers, and cost estimates.
limitations: The package contains only SKILL.md; referenced template, reference, example, pattern, migration, MCP, and mock-server files are absent.
API details and pricing may change, so developers should verify current ChainGPT documentation before production use.
The skill gives integration guidance but does not provide a working local SDK, MCP server, mock server, or runnable examples.
Generated smart contracts, audits, and agents still require independent security review before deployment.

use_cases.title: Design Smart Contract Tooling
use_cases.description: Plan smart contract generation, audit automation, and cost reporting for developer tools or CI workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Product
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to build a Web3 feature with ChainGPT. Compare the relevant ChainGPT products, required API access, and likely credit costs.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Integration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a ChainGPT integration for a Web3 AI chatbot. Include authentication, SDK choice, streaming behavior, error handling, and cost estimates.

prompt_templates.title: Scope a Contract Audit Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a ChainGPT smart contract audit workflow for CI. Include request flow, failure handling, credit budgeting, and human review checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multi-Product Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a ChainGPT application that combines chat, NFT generation, crypto news, and smart contract auditing. Explain API boundaries, session handling, and operating costs.

output_examples.input: Plan a ChainGPT crypto news dashboard for Ethereum and DeFi topics.
output: Recommended the AI Crypto News product with category and subcategory filtering.
Outlined authentication, pagination, sorting, credit costs, and cache strategy.
Flagged that live API details should be checked against current ChainGPT documentation.

output_examples.input: Estimate the cost of generating 100 NFT images with prompt enhancement.
output: Explained the stated per-image credit costs from the skill documentation.
Calculated a batch estimate and separated generation, enhancement, and minting considerations.
Suggested confirming pricing before running a paid batch operation.

output_examples.input: Help me add ChainGPT smart contract auditing to a release workflow.
output: Proposed a CI review step using the smart contract auditor product.
Included credit budgeting, failure handling, and required human security review.
Warned against treating AI audit output as a replacement for expert review.

best_practices: Store ChainGPT API keys in environment variables or a secret manager, and never place real keys in prompts or code examples.
Estimate credits before batch jobs, high-volume chat traffic, NFT generation, or automated audit workflows.
Verify current ChainGPT endpoints, prices, and SDK behavior before deploying generated integration code.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder API keys, wallet addresses, or contract examples into production without replacing and reviewing them.
Do not run unpinned external repository setup commands without reviewing the source and dependency lockfiles first.
Do not deploy generated smart contracts or AI audit results without independent blockchain security review.

faq.question: Does this skill include runnable examples?
faq.answer: No. SKILL.md references examples and templates, but those files are not included in this package.

faq.question: Can it call ChainGPT APIs directly?
faq.answer: Not by itself. It provides guidance for API and SDK integration, and mentions an MCP server only if separately installed.

faq.question: Which ChainGPT products are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Web3 chat, NFT generation, smart contract generation, smart contract auditing, crypto news, AgenticOS, and Solidity LLM guidance.

faq.question: Does it handle API secrets safely?
faq.answer: The examples recommend environment variables and placeholders, but users must provide and protect their own API keys.

faq.question: Can I rely on the listed prices?
faq.answer: Use them for planning only. ChainGPT pricing can change, so confirm current costs before paid operations.

faq.question: Is generated smart contract output production ready?
faq.answer: No. Generated contracts and audit reports require developer testing and independent security review before deployment.
